Wells Fargo Interview Experience 
Joy Purohit 
 
 
Online Test: 
 
There were 3 sections in the online exam. 
 
Section 1 was basically general vocabulary questions and reading passages. 
The questions are basic , just try to do it fast. 
 
Section 2 consisted of some questions related to stocks,airline tickets,finance etc based 
on a passage. Basically some information was given and steps to analyze that data, 
and the questions were based on interpreting and analyzing the data. Just make sure to 
read the question properly and don’t spend a lot of time on any question. 
 
Section 3 was the coding round. It had 2 questions: 
 
1. In the first question we had to arrange an array into groups of 3 like (a,b,c) wherein 
b/a==c/b.We had to print all such groups. With the brute force approach I was able to 
pass 6/20 test cases , and after optimizing it I was able to pass 15/20 test cases. 
 
2. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/generate-all-binary-strings-from-given-pattern/ 
 
I was able to pass1 14/14 test cases. 
 
31 students were shortlisted for ROUND 2. 
Round 2: 
TECHNICAL 
 
Questions asked: 
• Introduce yourself 
• What is cache? State its benefits. 
• What is LRU algorithm 
• What is LRU cache 
• To code the get and set function of LRU cache , 
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/design-a-data-structure-for-lru-cache/

Here first I gave a O(n) solution and coded it, and then I was asked to 
optimize it further to O(1) and I was able to do it using linked lists( I 
wasn’t asked to code it) 
 
16 students were selected for Round 3. 
 
Round 3: 
 
TECHNICAL + HR 
• Introduce yourself. 
• Why are you applying for a intern at Wells Fargo. 
I was then asked 5 puzzles , I had to give the logic to solve them and also had to 
code it up 
The puzzles were: 
• https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzle-9-find-the-fastest-3-horses/ 
• There are 2 burning ropes and you have a timer , measure 45 minutes. 
• Design a function which takes parameters (start time,current time,end time), 
The time is from the 24’hour clock and the time may or may not be of the 
same day, check if the current time is valid 
Current time is valid if: 
1. Curr>start && curr<end 
       There were more 2 puzzles but I don’t remember them , 1 was of easy difficulty and 
1 was of hard difficulty. 
 
NOTE: 
• I wasn’t asked any questions on DBMS, Projects but others were asked, so 
questions asked highly depends on the interviewer , so be prepared for the 
worst. 
 
6 Students were selected for the internship. 
 
NOTE: 
There was a HR round the next day which was just a formality but also be prepared 
with the HR questions , it might happen for you. 
Tips: 
• For DSA, I followed 
1. Top interview questions on leetcode.

2. Blind 75 curated list. 
3. Must do coding questions on gfg. 
4. https://hackernoon.com/14-patterns-to-ace-any-coding-interview-question-
c5bb3357f6ed 
Good resources you can try out: 
1. https://www.interviewbit.com/practice/ 
2. Strivers List 
3. 450 DSA 
4. https://github.com/yash0530/InterviewPrepResources 
 
For OS: 
• Gate Smashers (Youtube) 
 
For DBMS: 
• https://www.interviewbit.com/sql-interview-questions/ 
• Go through B tress , B+ trees on gate smashers and indexing on knowledge gate 
(Youtube) 
 
Puzzles: 
• https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzles/ 
 
 
Just be honest  , confident and keep smiling in the interview.  
While approaching a DSA questions keep explaining your thought 
process to the interviewer, always start with brute force and then 
optimize it.
